nse:106830108.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830108.answer: In the Q2 FY26 call (October 2025), management guided FY26 revenue at ~₹12,500 crore with ~5% growth in FY27, and average margins of 15%+. Earlier, in Q4 FY25 (May 2025), they guided 8%-10% revenue growth and 15% PBT margins. The Q2 FY27 result (₹2,446.1 crore revenue, down 16.5%; PAT slump of 53.8%) falls short of these expectations.

evidence.quote: We anticipate that this year, we will have revenue of approximately INR 12,500 crores or so. And the coming year also, we should have may be another 5% growth over that
But on an average, we can anticipate around 15% plus margins
As the Director of Finance has brought out, we expect the revenue growth of anywhere between 8% to 10% and our PBT margins we expect around 15%

nse:106837394.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106837394.answer: Management did not give specific aggregate group revenue or margin targets for Q2 FY27 in prior call transcripts. During the Q1 FY27 call (July 2026), they discussed strategy, noting retail margin pressure from online investments, full capitalization of Jio 5G, and strong O2C dynamics. Detailed aggregate numbers for Q2 FY27 were reported on the Q2 call (October 2026).

evidence.quote: So, as we increase the growth of digital revenues, margins have come down. It is a function of that. And that is a consistent trend over the last three quarters
EBITDA margin at 53.3%, EBIT Rs. 13,407 crores and profit after tax at Rs. 764 crores, the finance cost has gone up. It is really because we are now expensing it, we are not capitalizing it
It was an EBITDA of Rs.62,409 Crores, which is 24% up on a year-on￾year basis

nse:106836523.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106836523.answer: In August 2026, management expected 20–25% QoQ smartphone volume growth for Q2 FY27 while cautioning on margin pressure. In November 2026, management reported Q2 revenues of ₹21,806 crore, EBITDA of ₹609 crore, and PAT of ₹293 crore (consolidated), noting margins were compressed by mobile PLI 1 expiration and elevated global memory costs.

evidence.quote: Revenues for the quarter ended September 30, 2026 was INR 21,806 crores
Margins during the quarter were impacted on expiration of mobile PLI 1 scheme along with elevated global memory prices due to rapid expansion of AI infrastructure

Our market position, customer engagement and manufacturing capabilities remain intact, and we expect 20% to 25% volume growth quarter￾on-quarter growth as consumer demand strengthens and we have a strong order book

nse:106845578.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106845578.answer: In August 2026 (Q1 FY27), management guided full-year organic growth of 18% and PAT growth of 25% (revenue ~₹825 crore, PAT ~₹137 crore). Following an October TLS security incident, management cut FY27 guidance in November 2026 to ~₹800 crore revenue and ~₹125 crore PAT. Q2 FY27 actuals met expectations with ₹207.0 crore revenue (+19.7% YoY).

evidence.quote: Finally, from an outlook perspective, our guidance remains unchanged from what we shared in the previous quarter, that is to achieve an organic growth of 18% and work towards achieving a PAT growth of 25%

At the start of the year, we guided a revenue of about INR 825 crores and PAT of about INR 137 crores, about 25% PAT growth. We now expect our revenue to be about INR 800 crore and PAT of around INR 125 crore
In the second quarter, total income was INR 209 crore, up nearly 20% over last year. The EBITDA was INR 51.3 crore at a margin of 24.5%; and profit after tax was INR 33.4 crore, up 26% on YoY basis

nse:106834360.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834360.answer: On the Q1 FY27 call (July 2026), management guided for Q2 FY27 PRASK growth of more than 25% year-on-year. On the Q2 FY27 call (November 2026), management confirmed PRASK grew 31%, exceeding guidance. Reported Q2 revenue grew 25.9% YoY to ₹23,363.8 crore with an EBITDA margin of 7.3% (EBITDAR margin ~11%), matching their strong revenue performance expectations despite net losses.

evidence.quote: In terms of unit passenger revenue or PRASK for Q2FY27, with the current balanced demand￾supply equation and the higher fares holding up, we are expecting growth of more than 25% compared to the same period last year
Third, in this environment, we delivered a 31 percent increase in PRASK, which exceeded our guidance of more than 25 percent growth
In terms of profitability, EBITDAR came in at 25 billion rupees, at a margin of around 11 percent, compared to an EBITDAR of 11 billion rupees and a margin of 6 percent for the same period last year

nse:106830133.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106830133.answer: Management did not discuss raising money or issuing credit facilities in either call. In May 2025, management stated that the company holds Rs. 11,000 to Rs. 12,000 crores in cash and does not expect to take on debt for capex due to a healthy balance sheet, adding in October 2025 that it does not have much borrowings.

evidence.quote: As of now, we are having quite healthy Balance Sheet and we do not expect, but it will be based on the economic performance, we will see
I don't think it will be having any impact because we are not having any much borrowings, so it is almost the same

nse:106836275.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106836275.answer: In Q1 FY27 and Q2 FY27 calls, management maintained its full-year FY27 top-line guidance of high single-digit growth given at the beginning of the year, while not giving specific quarterly margin targets. The filing's Q2 FY27 revenue growth of 35.0% YoY significantly exceeds management's high single-digit growth expectation.

evidence.quote: would suggest that we should look at holding on to the overall guideline that we have shared with you earlier on.
Regarding the guidance, I think we'll stick to what guidance we have given at the beginning of the year

nse:106834087.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106834087.answer: In the July 29, 2026 call, management noted Q2 traditionally sees lower margins due to product mix, while maintaining full-year PBDIT margin guidance of 18% to 20%. The reported Q2 FY27 standalone results match this: revenue grew 14.9% to ₹8,453.8 crore, and PBDIT margin dipped to 17.0%, while H1 margin stayed within target at 19.6%.

evidence.quote: What we have seen is that quarter two has traditionally been a lower margin because of the mix of what we sell in quarter two overall
We are still garnering around the guidance of 18-20% of our PBDIT margins holds
Historically we have seen that, this has been a little bit of a soft quarter from a point of view of the bottom line, especially because today the product mix in this quarter is a little bit subdued

nse:106829089.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106829089.answer: In August 2026, management declined to give specific overall revenue or margin guidance, stating Bluetile/BestPlay margins would depend on spend opportunities and seasonality. For Q2 FY27, management reported record consolidated revenue of ₹803 crore and 14.9% EBITDA margin (up 311 bps YoY), again declining to give exact forward guidance in October 2026, targeting qualitative organic/inorganic growth.

evidence.quote: At Nazara level, do we want to give any guidance in terms of revenue, EBITDA, or margin? Nitish Mittersain: Not at this point of time
Q2 was a record quarter for us: Revenue was INR 803 crores, our highest ever, up 53% year-on￾year. EBITDA grew 93% to INR 120 crores and EBITDA margin expanded 311 basis points to 14.9%

We are not giving exact guidance right now. As you know, I just entered the job, but what I can say is that we are consistently going to expect growth, both organically and inorganically, from both the studios and the central group

nse:106836183.question: What has management said about raising money: how much, why, and what it is for?
nse:106836183.answer: Management reported completing a ₹780 crore QIP in Q1 FY27 and a subsequent 60:40 partly paid rights issue to strengthen liquidity, deleverage, and gain financial flexibility. Most raised cash went toward adding capacity or paying down debt. Additionally, they plan to raise external equity directly into the cell company to expand capacity from 6 GWh to 20 GWh.

evidence.quote: The balance sheet strengthened during the quarter through the successful completion of a ₹780 crore QIP, giving us greater financial flexibility as we pursue the next phase of our growth
Most of the cash we have raised has gone either into adding capacity or into paying down debt during this period
Once we stabilise 6 GWh, over the next couple of quarters, we will definitely look to go to 20 GWh, and we will do that by bringing external equity into the cell company

nse:106830187.question: What had management said on recent calls about revenue and margins for this period, and does this result match it?
nse:106830187.answer: Management did not discuss this on its last two calls.

nse:106867910.question: What has management said on recent calls about leadership, succession or this role?
nse:106867910.answer: In April 2026 (Q4 FY26), management stated the leadership transition was largely complete after onboarding heads of Retail Banking, Global Markets, Chief Risk Officer, and Chief Information Officer. The Board approved appointing Jagdeep Mallareddy and Ganesh Sankaran as Executive Director designates. In July 2026 (Q1 FY27), management highlighted focus shifted to execution under the strengthened leadership team.

evidence.quote: Our leadership transition is now largely completed, and the strengthened leadership team brings diverse experience, and a strong execution mindset
The Board has approved appointment of Jagdeep Mallareddy and Ganesh Sankaran as Whole Time Executive Director Designate
During the quarter, our focus was on strengthening the franchise, operating model and execution capabilities under the new leadership team to create a stronger foundation for future growth
